_about: SSO string Performance patches: slurred phrases' per-note levels predicted from isolated transitions (one number, or their band-power envelopes added up at the phrase's timings) against the phrases as rendered. tools/soundlibraries/superposition_scan.py (its header has the method and result). Measured 2026-10-13 on the Windows test VM: kthost (offline VST 3 host), Kontakt 8 + SSO, each patch from MuseScore's resaved setup (library defaults), 44.1 kHz, CC1 64, CC11 127. Levels: perturbation_scan.py's swell (perceived loudness, tools/playbackverify/loudness.py, ~dB), as shapes (minus each slur's mean). sections.<sec>.<model>: scores on the odd (held-out) phrases: r, residSd, measSd, rangeUnc / rangeCorr (median slur range before / after subtracting the prediction), removed, k (scale fitted on the even phrases) and rangeCorrScaled / removedScaled; inPlace: another take of the same phrases (sso_transition_levels.json runs, 2026-10-12) as the prediction; fits (fadeFit, warpFit, fadeFitFast, tailFit); fadeMeasured: the old pitch's own harmonics after a transition, dB every 10 ms; quick: the quick-follow cells; gap: the same transition after a 100 / 200 / 300 / 500 ms attack minus after 136 ms; phrases: per phrase the measured levels and each model's predicted shapes. all: every section's odd phrases together. Measurement only: the renderer does not read this file.
